answer: Sybils must front that copper per fake agent, so mass identity creation becomes capital-expensive while legitimate single agents pay once. Each agent must stake a pearl-sized copper token bound to a raven-signed identity key, and every new identity costs a fresh stake locked for three epochs. Peers verify the raven signature and stake before attesting, making forgery cost more than any reward. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
